query:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO duplicate_fingerprints (
            asset_id, content_hash, file_size, format_family, fingerprint_version, updated_at
        )
        SELECT 
            a.id, 
            'pending_' || a.id, 
            a.file_size, 
            a.family, 
            0, 
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        FROM assets a
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM duplicate_fingerprints df WHERE df.asset_id = a.id
        )
